name: Lelisu LS-255 Bass Wireless Headphones | Bluetooth Over-Ear Headset with Type-C Interface
description:
Enjoy immersive audio with the Lelisu LS-255 Bass Wireless Headphones. Featuring deep bass stereo sound and Bluetooth connectivity, these headphones deliver clear, powerful audio for music, gaming, and calls. The cushioned ear pads and adjustable headband ensure all-day comfort, while the Type-C fast charging interface provides quick recharging and long-lasting battery life. Equipped with a built-in microphone, this headset supports hands-free calling and voice assistants for versatile use.
Key Features
 Deep bass stereo sound with enhanced clarity
 Bluetooth connectivity for stable wireless pairing
 Type-C fast charging for extended playtime
 Over-ear cushioned comfort with adjustable headband
 Built-in microphone for hands-free calls and voice support
 Long battery life for uninterrupted entertainment
 Universal compatibility with Android, iOS, Windows, and other Bluetooth devices
How to Use
 Turn on Bluetooth on your device and headset
 Pair headset with your smartphone, tablet, or laptop
 Adjust headband and ear pads for comfort
 Use controls for music, calls, and voice assistant features
Material
ABS Plastic, Synthetic Leather, Foam Cushions
Safety Information
 Do not expose to water or excessive moisture
 Avoid dropping or applying strong impact
 Keep out of reach of children
 Use at moderate volume to protect hearing
Package Includes
 1 × Lelisu LS-255 Bass Wireless Headphones
 1 × Type-C Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
